text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Good question, huh? I'm feeling… whatevs.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's fiiine. With my effort level at rock bottom, I've got the mental clarity I need to score an easy victory.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Like… I'll skillfully lure my opponents right into my trap, and get handed the win.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Fortunate for us, everything's already set in place. Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Come on now, Trainer. Relaaax… Just droop your shoulders and point your peepers.
